test_title: PYST 31: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 22 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the word segment from the given options that substitutes the highlighted word segment correctly and completes the sentence meaningfully: -

Each of the participants__ were __given a certificate.
solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. was given.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The subject of the sentence is **"Each of the participants."** The word **"each"** is singular and requires a singular verb.
 
• In the given sentence, the verb **"were"** is incorrect because it is plural, which does not agree with the singular subject **"each."**
 
• The correct singular verb to use is **"was."**

Correct sentence: *Each of the participants **was given** a certificate.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Subject-Verb Agreement:**

 
 
• When **"each"** is used as the subject, it is always singular and requires a singular verb (e.g., was, has, is).
 
• Example: Each of the students **is** responsible for their own work.
 
 
 
• **Common Errors:**
 
 
• Using a plural verb with **"each."**
 
• Incorrect: Each of the members **are** present.
 
• Correct: Each of the members **is** present.
